what_it_does: RF circuit simulation (designing radio components) uses harmonic balance, a mathematical technique that finds steady-state behavior. Solving these equations is slow because it requires Newton's method, which iterates many times. This work proposes new preconditioners—mathematical transformations that rearrange the problem to make solvers converge faster. The contribution includes techniques that work in the time domain and extend to complex distributed circuits, plus a new way to predict which preconditioner will work best for a given design.
